name: Containerize: Dockerfile(s), compose.prod.yml, schema bootstrap, production config seam
outcome: Containerized the stack: Dockerfile.api (API + worker + beat + schema one-shot), a standalone Next image, compose.prod.yml on named volumes with no host ports, a pinned uv.lock and .env.prod.example — proven in an isolated local smoke (six services healthy, 18 tables, /api/health through the rewrite from the edge network) and torn down clean
